scholarly_carrier.author: Gyula Priskin
scholarly_carrier.title: The Dendera zodiacs as narratives of the myth of Osiris, Isis, and the child Horus

ancient_or_primary_corpus_citations_expo.source_derived_content: IV Akhet 12 is explicitly associated with dnj.t; Priskin reads this as the seventh lunar day/first-quarter operator used to reconstruct the start of the mysteries.
The Khoiak text connects work of dnj.t with the sixteen divine relics/localities of Osiris.
The inscription as translated by Cauville/Priskin names Osiris as the moon, Sah as a god/star figure and Sopdet as a goddess/star figure in one celestial sequence, with the stars rising and setting.
Priskin cites the Khoiak text for the one-day cloth activities around IV Akhet 20/21, a major phase of the mysteries in his 52 BCE astronomical reconstruction.

same_complex_bridge.meaning: The Osirian chapels/Dendera X corpus itself contains both the ritual/lunar Khoiak clock and explicit Osiris-Sah-Sopdet celestial language in the same broader monument/corpus.
same_complex_bridge.not_meaning: These elements are not yet shown to be one sentence or one ancient passage explicitly declaring that a particular Khoiak day equals the heliacal rising of Sirius.

key_dates: 25 September 52 BCE — autumnal equinox/full moon/lunar eclipse
10 October 52 BCE — II Akhet 6, new-moon/conception node
20 November 52 BCE — III Akhet 17, civil death-of-Osiris node discussed by Priskin
15 December 52 BCE — IV Akhet 12, start of Osiris mysteries / dnj.t
16 July 51 BCE approximately — heliacal rising of Sirius at Dendera, with visibility uncertainty of roughly one or two days
scholarly_absolute_reconstruction.model_scope: Dendera zodiac and Khoiak/Osirian-chapel astronomical interpretation around 52-51 BCE; not a universal ancient Egyptian chronology of a literal historical Osiris.

important_event_typing.OSIRIS_RETURN_REVIVAL: A separate 2019 Priskin conference abstract describes the agricultural motif as Osiris coming back to life when the sown corn begins to sprout on II Akhet 6. Crosswalking the civil date to Priskin's 52 BCE model yields 10 October 52 BCE as a reconstruction-specific return/revival candidate.
important_event_typing.SIRIUS_REAPPEARANCE: approximately 16 July 51 BCE at Dendera in the reconstruction.
important_event_typing.PHALLUS_RECOVERY: Khoiak ritual day 25 or 28 in variant lists; not assigned a universal historical/mythic date by this trace.
important_event_typing.rule: RETURN != MYSTERIES_START != DEATH != SIRIUS_RISING != PHALLUS_RECOVERY != LITERAL_ARRIVAL

missing_tooth_after_trace.refined_description: The broad scholarly synchronizer is now substantially present. What remains missing for the strongest claim is an ancient passage or securely source-bound rule that explicitly maps the exact event type JANUS wants to date to the Sirius/Khoiak clock without relying on modern interpretive synthesis.
missing_tooth_after_trace.name: EVENT_TYPED_DIRECT_ANCIENT_SYNCHRONIZER

analysis_of_analysis.change_from_parent: The missing gear is narrower than before. We no longer lack every Sirius-Khoiak connection: same-complex ancient citations plus a coherent scholarly absolute reconstruction exist. We still lack authorization to collapse distinct mythic/ritual events into one 'arrival' date.
analysis_of_analysis.most_important_correction: The ambiguity of the word ARRIVAL is now at least as important as the chronology gap itself.
analysis_of_analysis.falsifier: If direct Dendera/Cauville text is found explicitly synchronizing the exact target event with Sirius or if Priskin's cited primary references do not support the claimed lunar/celestial relations, reclassify accordingly.

claim_ceiling: This trace relies on Priskin's published citations/translations to Dendera X/1 and does not claim a new independent philological translation of the hieroglyphic source.
The absolute Julian dates are modern scholarly reconstruction, not dates literally written in the Egyptian inscriptions.
The same-corpus bridge is stronger than a loose thematic association but weaker than a direct single-passage synchronizer.
No external sender, prophecy or literal divine arrival is established.
canonical_seal: THE GEAR IS PARTLY FOUND: DENDERA HOLDS BOTH CLOCKS IN ONE COMPLEX. THE LAST MISSING TOOTH IS EVENT-TYPED DIRECT SYNCHRONIZATION. NAME THE EVENT BEFORE NAMING THE DATE.
